data.one_liner: An easy way to display, animate, and style checkmark icons in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated checkmark widgets that support checking, unchecking, and undetermined states by boolean or double progress values. Allows customization of color, weight, size, and line styles.
use_when: You need an animated checkmark icon for forms, toggles, or success states.
You want to animate between check, cross, or undetermined states.
avoid_when: You only need a static, non-animated checkmark icon.
You are looking for a complete UI component set.
strengths: Supports animation by boolean or progress value.
Customizable weight, size, color, and rounded or sharpened line styles.
Supports cross and dash drawing options.
weaknesses: Limited to checkmark and related simple path animations.
Assumes the checkmark is always displayed in a square format.
data.minimal_example:
Checkmark(
  checked: true,
  indeterminate: false,
  size: 12,
  color: Colors.blue,
  drawCross: true,
  drawDash: false,
);
